verdict.rationale: Mercury Books explicitly connects banking, cards, invoicing, bill pay natively, plus third-party payments/payroll integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Gusto) and external bank/payroll linking, with automatic categorization and real-time reconciliation feeding the ledger. Mercury itself candidly notes automation has limits and still needs human review, which is a reasonable caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of integration reliability and broader payroll/payment provider coverage beyond Gusto/Stripe/PayPal.
